"""
================
accelerometer.py
================

:summary:
    Contains the virtual accelerometer classes for producing measurements.
    This module contains virtual accelerometer classes that can be used for
    generating accelerometer measurements, from a simulated environment,
    with a configured level of noise/errors.

:authors:
    | Prof. Jason Ralph - jfralph@liverpool.ac.uk
    | Michael Wright - mjwright@liverpool.ac.uk

:version:
    1.0.0 - First full implementation of module.
"""

import numpy as np

from nav_toolbox.core.transformations import cross_prod_xy
from nav_toolbox.core.transformations import rotate_3d
from nav_toolbox.core.constants import G




[docs]
class StandardAccelerometer:
    """
    Provides the functionality of an accelerometer in a simulated environment.
    This class essentially represents a virtual accelerometer converting
    waypoint accelerations to body rate axis and applying noise/errors.
    The output of this can then be passed to a selected INS solution.
    """

    # All properties of the class.
    __slots__ = \
        '__acc_bias_error', \
        '__acc_bias_drift_rate', \
        '__acc_scale_error', \
        '__acc_non_ort_err', \
        '__acc_avg_meas_noise', \
        '__acc_avg_meas_noise_mg', \
        '__acc_meas_noise', \
        '__sensor_angles_rad', \
        '__rot_body2sensor', \
        '__lever_angles', \
        '__error_matrix', \
        '__frequency', \
        '__rng'

    def __init__(self, freq: float,
                 acc_bias_error: np.ndarray = np.zeros(3),
                 acc_bias_drift_rate: float = 1,
                 acc_scale_error: np.ndarray = np.zeros(3),
                 acc_non_ort_err: np.ndarray = np.zeros(6),
                 acc_avg_meas_noise: float = 1,
                 rand_seed: int = None):
        """
        Initialises an accelerometer instance with configured errors/rates.

        :param freq: The frequency of accelerometer measurements (in Hz).
        :type freq: float

        :param acc_bias_error: The initial accelerometer bias errors
            (in micro-g).
        :type acc_bias_error: numpy.array (3-elements)

        :param acc_bias_drift_rate: The accelerometer bias drift rate
            (in micro-g/root sec).
        :type acc_bias_drift_rate: float

        :param acc_scale_error: The accelerometer scale errors (in ppm).
        :type acc_scale_error: numpy.array (3-elements)

        :param acc_non_ort_err: The accelerometer non-orthogonal errors
            (in micro-g).
        :type acc_non_ort_err: numpy.array (6-elements)

        :param acc_avg_meas_noise: The average accelerometer measurement
            error (in micro-g.root Hz).
        :type acc_avg_meas_noise: float

        :param rand_seed: The optional initialisation seed to use to
            generate random numbers for noise and other errors.
        :type rand_seed: int
        """

        assert freq > 0, \
            'Accelerometer measurement frequency must be a positive value!'

        assert acc_bias_error.size == 3, \
            "Accelerometer bias error must have 3 elements!"

        assert acc_scale_error.size == 3, \
            "Accelerometer scale error must have 3 elements!"

        assert acc_non_ort_err.size == 6, \
            "Accelerometer non-orthogonal error must have 6 elements!"

        self.__frequency = freq
        self.__acc_bias_error = acc_bias_error
        self.__acc_bias_drift_rate = acc_bias_drift_rate
        self.__acc_scale_error = acc_scale_error
        self.__acc_non_ort_err = acc_non_ort_err
        self.__acc_avg_meas_noise = acc_avg_meas_noise

        # Initialise the sensor and lever angles
        self.__sensor_angles_rad = np.radians(np.array([0, 0, 0]))
        self.__lever_angles = np.array([0, 0, 0])

        # Initialise the random number generator
        self.__rng = np.random.default_rng(rand_seed)

        # Accelerometer average noise
        self.__acc_avg_meas_noise_mg = acc_avg_meas_noise * G * 1e-6
        self.__acc_meas_noise = self.__acc_avg_meas_noise_mg * self.__rng.normal(size=3)
        # self.__acc_meas_noise = self.__acc_avg_meas_noise_mg * np.random.randn(3)

        # Body to sensor rotation matrix
        self.__rot_body2sensor = rotate_3d(*self.__sensor_angles_rad)

        # Initialise the error matrix
        self.__error_matrix = (np.array([
            [acc_scale_error[0], acc_non_ort_err[0], acc_non_ort_err[1]],
            [acc_non_ort_err[2], acc_scale_error[1], acc_non_ort_err[3]],
            [acc_non_ort_err[4], acc_non_ort_err[5], acc_scale_error[2]]
        ]) * 1.0e-6) + np.eye(3)



[docs]
    def update(self, dt_sqrt: float):
        """
        Called every iteration to update simulated sensor errors.
        As sensor errors propagate with time, it is important that this
        method is called prior to every measurement update.

        :param dt_sqrt: Square of the time difference since the last update.
        :type dt_sqrt: float
        """
        self.__acc_bias_error += \
            self.__acc_bias_drift_rate * dt_sqrt * self.__rng.normal(size=3)
        # self.__acc_bias_drift_rate * dt_sqrt * np.random.randn(3)

        self.__acc_meas_noise = \
            self.__acc_avg_meas_noise_mg * self.__rng.normal(size=3)


        # self.__acc_avg_meas_noise_mg * np.random.randn(3)



[docs]
    def get_measurement(self, true_acceleration: np.ndarray, true_angle_rates: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        """
        Produces an accelerometer measurement from given truth data.
        This method converts the given waypoint data to body axes and
        applies the configured errors/noise. The output can then be
        fed to the selected INS solution.

        :param true_acceleration: The true acceleration values read from the
            simulation waypoint data (North, East and Down components
            in metres/second).
        :type true_acceleration: numpy.array (3-elements)

        :param true_angle_rates: The true angle rates values read from the
            simulation waypoint data (P, Q and R angles in degrees/second).
        :type true_angle_rates: numpy.array (3-elements)

        :return: The measured acceleration of the accelerometer.
            (North, East and Down components in metres/second).
        :rtype: numpy.array (3-elements)
        """

        # Calculate the lever arm effect
        # angle_rate_acc = np.cross(true_angle_rates, np.cross(
        #     true_angle_rates, self.__lever_angles))

        angle_rate_acc = cross_prod_xy(true_angle_rates, cross_prod_xy(
            true_angle_rates, self.__lever_angles))

        acceleration_s = self.__rot_body2sensor.dot(
            true_acceleration + angle_rate_acc)

        # Obtain the bias and noise errors
        acc_bias_errors = self.__acc_bias_error * 1e-6 * G

        # Apply measurement, bias and noise errors
        acceleration_s = self.__error_matrix.dot(
            acceleration_s) + acc_bias_errors + self.__acc_meas_noise

        return acceleration_s

    def get_update_freq(self) -> float:
        """
        Returns the accelerometer measurement frequency in Hz.

        :return: The measurement frequency in Hz.
        :rtype: float
        """
        return self.__frequency
